title: Modern Portfolio
intent: A portfolio site for a design engineer that a recruiter can judge in two minutes and a peer can read for an evening, built on Minimaly to find what a tool-UI system lacks for an editorial site.
note: Fictional person and content: replace Noa Lindqvist, the projects and the articles with your own.

states.note: Positioning, three projects, now, latest articles, contact call

states.note: Phone menu drawer open, current page marked

states.name: Filtered
states.note: Systems filter on: two projects, count updated

states.name: Default
states.note: Headings, code, quote, related work and articles

states.name: Long title
states.note: Four-line title, wraps without breaking the head

states.name: Error
states.note: Email and message refused: they shake once, values kept

flows.name: Evaluate in two minutes
flows.statement: As a recruiter, I should be able to judge one project in depth and reach the person right after.

flows.name: Read and find the work
flows.statement: As a peer, I should be able to read an article and open the project behind it.

flows.name: Send a message
flows.statement: As a visitor, I should be able to send a message and know it arrived.

qa.q: Why does every project card open the Fieldnote case study?
qa.a: The template ships one complete case study as the model. Copy case-study.html once per project and point its card to the copy.

qa.q: Why does every article open the same page?
qa.a: Same reason: article.html is the model article. One copy per article.

qa.q: What does the contact form check?
qa.a: Name, a valid email and a message. Each refused field shakes once and says what to fix; typed values stay.
Nowhere yet: sending is simulated. Wire the form to a form service or an API route when you start from the template.
The site follows the theme set on its html element, here the handoff toggle. A real site adds a switch or reads the system setting.

questions: Article rows: list titles are 12 px, too small for an article list. Add a large list variant, or keep a local row for sites?

Theme switch: component color transitions run when data-theme changes, so a switch is ragged and the render lint, 50 ms after it, reads start colors. Should ds.js switch themes without transitions? Done here in screens.js.
Validator: async-button and hold-button share the .btn class and toast is created by script, so M204 calls them unused. Detect them by data-busy, data-hold and toast() calls?
